# Cloud Solutions Architect, Presales

Job ID: REQ-48213
Posted: 6 days ago
Location: Toronto, Ontario (Hybrid, 3 days in office)
Department: Solutions Engineering
Employment type: Full-time, permanent

[Apply now]   [Save job]

## Overview

Cobalt Ridge Systems is a mid-sized cloud consultancy helping financial services and retail clients
migrate and modernise workloads on public cloud. We are hiring a Cloud Solutions Architect to join
our presales team. You will partner with account executives to shape technical proposals, run
discovery workshops and present target architectures to client leadership.

[Apply now]

## Responsibilities

- Lead technical discovery sessions with client engineering and security teams.
- Translate business goals into cloud architectures covering compute, networking, data and security.
- Produce solution designs, effort estimates and statements of work with the delivery team.
- Deliver architecture presentations and live demonstrations to technical and executive audiences.
- Respond to RFPs and RFIs, owning the technical sections.
- Build proof-of-concept environments using infrastructure as code.
- Hand over won engagements to delivery leads and stay available as a technical escalation point.
- Keep current on cloud provider roadmaps and certifications.

## Requirements

- 6+ years of experience in cloud architecture, consulting or engineering.
- Deep knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
- Experience designing landing zones, hybrid connectivity and migration strategies.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to present to non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience with Terraform or an equivalent infrastructure as code tool.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container platforms.
- Understanding of security and compliance frameworks used in financial services.

## Nice to have

- A professional-level cloud architect certification.
- Experience in a customer-facing or presales role at a consultancy or cloud partner.
- Experience with FinOps practices.
- French language skills.

## What we offer

- Competitive salary and annual performance bonus.
- Health and dental coverage from day one.
- Certification and training budget.
- Flexible hybrid working arrangement.
